table_title: Table 9.9.3.19.1: KSI and sequence number information element
rows: This field contains the 5 least significant bits of the NAS COUNT value applicable when this message is sent.
This field contains the key set identifier value, as specified in bit 1 to 3 of octet 1 of the NAS key set identifier information element. (see clause 9.9.3.21.)
